PAID PARENTAL LEAVE SCHEME
1. Qualifying service: at least 6 full months of employment on the date of the birth or placement.
2. Adoption: covered with the same entitlements when the child is under 16 years old at placement.
3. Secondary carer: 2 weeks of paid leave at full pay.
4. Coverage: permanent and fixed-term employees with at least 24 contracted hours per week. Contractors and agency workers are not covered.
5. Notice: the request must be submitted at least 8 weeks before the first day of leave.
6. Primary carer: 12 weeks of paid leave; the first 10 weeks at full pay, the rest at 80% of pay. A multiple birth adds 4 weeks per additional child, paid at 80%.
7. Timing: leave is one continuous block. It starts no earlier than the birth or placement date (a primary carer expecting a birth may start up to 2 weeks before the expected date) and no later than 3 months after that date. A request for more weeks than the entitlement cannot be approved as submitted.

7. Adoption: covered with the same entitlements when the child is under 5 years old at placement.

It starts no earlier than the birth or placement date (a primary carer expecting a birth may start up to 4 weeks before the expected date) and no later than 18 months after that date. A request for more weeks than the entitlement cannot be approved as submitted.
7. Notice: the request must be submitted at least 4 weeks before the first day of leave.
